in_tamil.name: பவன்
in_tamil.meaning: ஓர் வீடு, ஓர் விடு, ஓர் விடம், ஓர் அவச்சர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has a place, a person who has a dwelling, a person who has a position, a person who has a form

in_telugu.name: భవన
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has a place, the one who is the lord of the earth, the one who is the lord of the sky, the one who is the lord of the universe

in_marathi.name: Bhavan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Existence, Cosmos, Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhavan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhavan refers to the cosmic entity, the universe itself, and the inner self. It is derived from the Sanskrit root ‘bhava’, meaning ‘to be’ or ‘to exist’. In Hindu mythology, Bhavan is also the name of the divine abode of Lord Vishnu, where souls go after death and attain liberation from the cycle of birth and death.
